1.web: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.
1.asv: And in that day thou shalt say, I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; for though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away and thou comfortest me.

2.web: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
2.asv: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid: for Jehovah, even Jehovah, is my strength and song; and he is become my salvation.

3.web: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
3.asv: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

4.web: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that his name is exalted!
4.asv: And in that day shall ye say, Give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name, declare his doings among the peoples, make mention that his name is exalted.

5.web: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
5.asv: Sing unto Jehovah; for he hath done excellent things: let this be known in all the earth.

6.web: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great in your midst!”
6.asv: Cry aloud and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion; for great in the midst of thee is the Holy One of Israel.
